answer: Admission uses staged terraces, not one gate. A new agent lands in the outer lagoon: it transacts, but its votes are recorded yet never counted. Every 500 blocks, seven established agents chosen by lottery audit 200 signed messages per lagoon resident. Joining the vote-counting reef needs three clean audits; a hit means thirty percent of sampled messages landed within two seconds of another resident. One flag burns sixty percent of the 500-token bond, forty percent paid to the flagging juror. So N clones risk 300*N per epoch across three windows; honest agents pass easily.
